terminal/mode#

Terminal input modes, applied for a while and then restored.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let lease = session.apply(TerminalMode.raw);
defer lease.close();                          // restores the previous mode

Description#

Terminal input modes, applied for a while and then restored.

cooked is line editing with echo; cbreak gives each key at once, without echo, while Ctrl-C still signals; raw gives every byte at once, untranslated, without echo or signals; secret is cooked without echo, for passwords.
